level_one.title: Raven's Intellect
level_one.description: Raven Form increases Medivh's Mana and Health Regeneration by 75%.

level_four.title: Mage Armor
level_four.description: The first time an ally uses a Portal, they gain 30 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing their damage taken by 30%.

level_seven.title: Arcane Explosion
level_seven.description: When Force of Will expires, it deals 80 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, plus 50% of the damage it prevented, up to 315 (+4% per level) additional damage.

level_ten.title: Ley Line Seal
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Circle of Protection
level_thirteen.description: Force of Will also applies to allies near the target, but its cooldown is increased by 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Arcane Charge
level_sixteen.description: When Arcane Rift damages an enemy Hero, the next Arcane Rift deals 15% more damage.

level_one.title: Demolitions Expert
level_one.description: Quest: For every 5 enemy Heroes hit by Particle Grenade, its recharge rate lowers by 0.4375 seconds, up to 3.5 seconds.  Reward: Once Particle Grenade has hit 40 enemy Heroes, its radius is increased by 15%.

level_four.title: Speed Barrier
level_four.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

level_seven.title: Pinpoint Accuracy
level_seven.description: Particle Grenade deals 30 (+4% per level) more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

level_ten.title: Graviton Surge
level_ten.description: Launch a gravity bomb that detonates after 1 second and draws enemy Heroes toward the center for 2.5 seconds. Affected Heroes take 30 (+4% per level) damage a second.

level_thirteen.title: Unstoppable Competitor
level_thirteen.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Gain Train
level_sixteen.description: Shield Ally now grants an untalented Shield to a nearby ally upon impact.

level_twenty.title: Grenadier
level_twenty.description: All Particle Grenade charges are returned at once.
